description.narrative: Syftet med detta projekt är att höja fred, statsbyggande och europeisk agenda, genom samförståndsskapande, inkluderande policyskapande, expertinsatser, ökat politiskt och samhälleligt stöd för fred, utbilda politiska representanter, stödja regionalt samarbete och främja genomförandet av reformer.

The aim of this project is to elevate peace, state-building and European agenda, through consensus building, inclusive policymaking, expert input, increasing political and societal support for peace, educating political representatives, supporting regional cooperation, and advancing the implementation of reforms.

The aim of this project is to elevate peace, state-building and European agenda, through consensus building, inclusive policymaking, expert input, increasing political and societal support for peace, educating political representatives, supporting regional cooperation, and advancing the implementation of reforms.
The objective of this intervention is to strengthen Kosovo's participation in the EU led negotiations with Serbia, and also for more inclusive policymaking.
Improve consensus and inclusive policymaking and increase accountability by improving policymaking and policy-coordination processes. • Assist the political transition by empowering youth and equipping them with knowledge and skills. • Advance the Kosovo-Serbia dialogue by providing and increased expert support to the Government of Kosovo and the Kosovo negotiation team as well as increase the transparency and public outreach of the dialogue for citizens. • Assist Kosovos Assembly by providing expert support on the dialogue, oversight and specific law making aimed at increasing its capacity. The support will be used to better prepare for the dialogue with Serbia, aligned with the Government and build consensus in the assembly. • Provide expert support for the President of Kosovo in law making, check and balances, functioning of institutions, secure policies, dialogue with Serbia international cooperation. • Increase support for the Ministry of Defence Ministry by providing expertise and policy support. • Provide support for the ministry of Rerun and Communities and four northern Serb-majority municipalities through providing expert support and advice in the areas of governance, local governance, public policy and Kosovo law and administrative system. • Advance normalisation between Kosovo and Serbia by enhancing cooperation between civil society, communities, public officials, and experts of Kosovo and Serbia. • Enhance regional cooperation by increasing Kosovos participation in regional initiatives and agendas through policy inputs and agenda settings. • Promote the agenda of the government of Kosovo and other institutions; its needs and interest at broader European level through high-level advocacy events, outreach and dialogue. • Advance the implementation of EU approximation-related agendas, the SAA and ERA, through monitoring, mobilising institutions and public support

description.narrative:
Some of the examples of the results achieved by the project are: 1. Strengthened Analytical, Legal, and Policy Foundations for the EUFacilitated Dialogue. The project delivered a robust body of analytical, legal, and geopolitical documents that significantly improved Kosovos preparedness and coherence in the Dialogue. This included briefs, memos, scenario papers, legal analyses, and talking points creating a unified evidence base that strengthened Kosovos negotiating positions and professionalized interinstitutional preparation.
2. Enhanced Institutional Coordination, Documentation Systems, and Monitoring. The operationalization of the Dialogue Database, improved reporting processes, and strengthened coordination between OPM, MFA, and line ministries led to more consistent documentation, continuity across political cycles, and higher-quality reporting to the European Commission and international partners. This increased institutional efficiency and accountability.
3. Targeted expert support improved Kosovos readiness to implement the Brussels and Ohrid Agreements. This included sequenced implementation plans, legal assessments, and technical memos. A key milestone was the reactivation of the IBM Implementation Group (first since 2016), reflecting strengthened inter-ministerial coordination and renewed engagement on technical issues such as energy and missing persons.
4. Reinforced Cooperation and Alignment with the EUSR and International Partners. The project strengthened communication and coordination with the EUSR office, ensuring consistent, wellsubstantiated inputs across negotiation tracks. Regular exchanges, analytical briefings, and structured communication enhanced trust, increased clarity, and aligned Kosovos positions with EU facilitation frameworksboosting Kosovos credibility in Brussels.
5. Advancement of Peace, Security, Transitional Justice, and Human Rights Agendas. The experts supported major policy achievements, including the Statute for the Commission on Transitional Justice, progress on the Women, Peace, and Security agenda (including the WPS Global Forum), and strengthened engagement with NATO and security partners. Human rights, equality, and the inclusion of non-majority communities were mainstreamed across institutional processes, reinforcing Kosovos alignment with international norms.
6. Successful Engagement with the EU Growth Plan and Operational Readiness for the Reform and Growth Facility (RGF). Expert input enabled the approval and operationalization of the Growth Plan Reform Agenda, successful negotiation of the Facility and Loan Agreements, and alignment with EU visibility and reporting requirements. Kosovo strengthened its role in regional initiatives (CRM II, CEFTA) and improved compliance with EU principles, including gender mainstreaming.
7. Improved external communication and the project enhanced the quality, accuracy, and consistency of communication with both domestic audiences and international stakeholders. Legally sound messaging and targeted outreach improved Kosovos visibility and reputation on issues such as rule of law, human rights, transitional justice, and dialogue engagement receiving positive recognition in EU reporting.
